text: UT Dallas prepares students for leadership roles in science, engineering, business, research, the arts, government and the global community. Degrees & Certificates. From the arts and sciences to engineering and management, UT Dallas’ degree programs are honed to produce world-class graduates. UT Dallas offers a variety of academic and professional certificates, including teacher certification programs. Two Paths for Teacher Certification. UTeach Dallas: For STEM majors seeking certification to teach middle and high school math, science or computer science.

Teacher Development Center: For students and graduates from any academic discipline seeking Texas teacher certification. Schools & Honors College. Our seven schools embody the wealth of educational opportunities offered at the undergraduate, graduate and professional levels. The Hobson Wildenthal Honors College hosts academic, social and cultural events for students to pursue intellectual excellence and curiosity across the disciplines. Academic Resources. Academic resources include information about tutoring, transcripts, the academic calendar, courses, libraries, advising and the testing center. Innovation and Entrepreneurship

Program helps students transform ideas into real-world solutions through mentorship and interdisciplinary collaboration. UT Dallas Education Abroad offers many international. opportunities that will expand your worldview. Academic Calendar. UT Dallas’ academic year is based on three semesters: fall, spring and summer.
